text:
incident-bot: ALERT 1779101234 — prod/inference-api (us-west-2) reporting spike in 5xx and elevated latency. paging oncall@maria, oncall@devin. Auto-incident created: https://incidents.redwood/1779101234 :rotating_light:

maria: ack, I'm taking incident lead. Joining bridge now. Initial hypothesis: recent model weight rollout + cache miss storm. Starting mitigation steps, will post commands. :eyes:

devin: on my way. quick check: KV cache hit rate dropped about 30% around the spike start. grabbing logs and metric slices.

maria: mitigating — scaling gen pool and gating the new routing for a canary. Running rollback on the model route if scale doesn't bring error rate down.

maria: running commands now:
```bash
# increase pool size to reduce queuing
redwoodctl scale --cluster inference-prod-usw2 --pool gen-large --replicas 10
# set route to previous stable variant
redwoodctl route set inference-api --model redwood-v2-stable --variant stable --reason "rollout rollback due to spike"
```

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by maria (redwoodctl) — job 5773 started.

deploy-bot: deploy job 5773 completed successfully — route updated to redwood-v2-stable.

maria: after rollback: 5xx rate decreasing but still elevated. keeping bridge open. collecting traces for root cause.

devin: digging into prefix/KV cache — observed many cache keys with zero-ttl refresh attempts. Looks like a regression in cache TTL logic from the last commit. quick query: 
`SELECT count(*) as errors, sum(requests) as total FROM api_errors WHERE service="inference-api" AND ts > now()-1h;`

devin: query result snippet:
```
errors: 4200
total: 600000
error_rate: 0.7%
```

samir: thanks. can we get customer impact numbers? which tenants saw most failures (Dedicated vs Hosted)? also need to know if retries caused downstream load.

devin: early breakdown — approx 12 Dedicated tenants saw >1% error rate, three tenants (acct-42, acct-99, acct-ops) had noticeable retries. Hosted traffic accounted for bulk of requests but lower per-tenant impact. More precise CSV uploaded: https://internal.docs/incident/1779101234/impact.csv

jordan: I'll coordinate customer comms for the top 3 affected accounts, tagging AE team. Drafting a short note and will share for legal/ops review.

elaine: I can own the post-incident review and runbook edits. Proposed immediate runbook additions (please comment):
- Add step: "If 5xx > 0.5% for 10m AND P95 latency > baseline+50ms => trigger automatic route fallback to compatible variant"
- Add step: "On model rollout, enforce cache-health gate: require KV hit-rate >= 90% for 15m before increasing traffic"
- Add diagnostic checklist entries: `curl` queries + `redwoodctl` quick checks + link to trace view

elaine: suggested timeline: postmortem writeup draft due EOD 2026-03-19, review session Tues 2026-03-23 16:00 UTC. If that works, I'll create calendar and post the doc.

maria: ACTION: devin - root cause analysis for cache-ttl regression, include PR and blame, due 2026-03-18.
maria: ACTION: elaine - own postmortem doc + runbook edits, due 2026-03-19.
maria: ACTION: jordan - customer comms for top 3 impacted tenants, draft due 2026-03-17.

devin: taking RC analysis. preliminary: a recent change to cache serialization dropped TTL propagation for wrapper keys; reproducer and unit test in progress. Will PR remediation and backfill tests.

samir: please also add a monitoring alert to catch drop in KV hit-rate (new alert) and an automation to throttle rollout if cache-health gate fails. ACTION: samir - open infra ticket to add alert and gating automation, due 2026-03-20.

elaine: created the postmortem doc skeleton: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/1779101234 — added sections for timeline, mitigations, customer impact, action items. Please add notes and link artifacts (logs, traces, graphs).

maria: small note for playbook: add a short snippet for manual fallback command so oncall can execute quickly. Proposed snippet for runbook:
```
# manual fallback to stable variant
redwoodctl route set inference-api --model redwood-v2-stable --variant stable --reason "manual fallback - oncall"
```

devin: I'll submit PR to fix TTL and add unit tests. Also will add an e2e smoke that verifies TTL propagation on deploy. ACTION: devin - PR and e2e, due 2026-03-18.

jordan: AE outreach queued, shared draft with legal. Will post copy to postmortem doc once sent.

samir: one more ask — let's run a short runbook drill to exercise this new fallback flow before we mark actions done. Suggest a dry-run in staging next week. ACTION: maria & devin - schedule drill in staging, target week of 2026-03-22.

elaine: scheduling note: review session invite sent for 2026-03-23 16:00 UTC. Agenda: 1) timeline walk 2) root cause 3) action list + owners 4) runbook edits sign-off.

maria: wrap-up — incident declared resolved at 2026-03-15T02:41:14Z, 5xx and latency back to baseline after rollback and scale. Thanks to everyone on bridge. Will add a short timeline into the postmortem doc. :raised_hands:

incident-bot: INCIDENT 1779101234 status -> RESOLVED. Postmortem thread created: https://incidents.redwood/1779101234/postmortem.

maria: closing notes: keep communication in the postmortem doc for action tracking. If you take an action, add acceptance criteria and link PR/issue.

devin: noted — will link PRs and tests to the postmortem.

elaine: marking actions as open in tracker. I'll follow up 3 days before due dates to keep momentum.

jordan: thanks team. I'll share customer comms copy here once sent.

samir: great work — let's aim to make the cache-health gate automated in the next sprint.

maria: thanks all, closing thread. :white_check_mark:
